questions.text: Describe a time you identified and responsibly escalated a significant security vulnerability.
Tell me about a time you had to balance security requirements with business speed. How did you approach it?
Describe a time you led or played a key role in a security incident response.
Tell me about a time you discovered that a security policy was not being followed. What did you do?
Describe a situation where you had to communicate a security risk to non-technical leadership.
Tell me about a time you implemented a security control that initially met resistance.
Describe a time you had to make a fast risk decision during a live security incident.
Tell me about a time you assessed competing risks and recommended a mitigation strategy.
Describe a time you worked with engineers or developers to fix a security flaw in their code.
Tell me about a time you performed a threat model for a new system or feature.
Describe a time you were under pressure to skip or delay a security review. What did you do?
Tell me about a time you discovered evidence of a data breach or intrusion. What did you do first?
Describe a time you helped build a security awareness culture within a non-security team.
Tell me about a time you had to decide whether to disclose a vulnerability publicly.
Describe a time you identified a systemic security weakness across multiple systems.
Tell me about a time you maintained confidentiality under pressure during an incident.
Describe a time you worked with legal or compliance teams during a security event.
Tell me about a time you had to adapt your security approach due to a change in the threat landscape.
Describe a time you found a false positive in your security monitoring and improved detection.
Tell me about a time you had to escalate a security concern that your manager initially dismissed.
Describe a time you ran a penetration test or red team exercise and what you uncovered.
Tell me about a time you designed or improved an access control or identity management process.
Describe a time you had to contain and recover from ransomware or a similar attack.
Tell me about a time you contributed to a security audit or compliance review.
Describe a time you helped a business team understand the security implications of a product decision.
Tell me about a time you had to update your security controls to address a zero-day vulnerability.
Describe a time you built or improved a security response playbook.
Tell me about a time you observed a colleague making a security mistake and how you handled it.
Describe a time you had to prioritize which vulnerabilities to fix first under limited resources.
Tell me about a time you worked with vendors or third parties on a security issue.
Describe a time you advised leadership on the business risk of accepting a security gap.
Tell me about a time you had to quickly get up to speed on a new attack technique.
Describe a time you participated in a tabletop exercise or simulated incident. What was your role?
Tell me about a time you identified a privacy risk in a product and what you recommended.
Describe a time you improved log management or SIEM alerting for your organization.
Tell me about a time you had to refuse a security shortcut requested by leadership.
Describe a time you helped a team ship a feature securely under a tight deadline.
Tell me about a time you had to coordinate a multi-team response to a security breach.
Describe a time you improved the security review process to reduce friction for developers.
Tell me about a time you had to work under ambiguity during a fast-moving security incident.
Describe a time you created or delivered security training to employees.
Tell me about a time you identified an insider threat risk and what actions you took.
Describe a time you improved security architecture for a cloud or on-prem environment.
Tell me about a time you had to report a security incident to regulators or customers.
Describe a time you held firm on a security standard even when it caused friction with a deadline.
